name: codex-delegate
description: Delegate one coding task from Claude Code to Codex through a blocking foreground launcher. It validates the live model pair, starts codex exec in a private process group, enforces a wall-clock deadline, reads the JSON terminal event, cleans up on completion or stop, and returns the final message with reduced status. Requires macOS, Python 3, and a signed-in Codex CLI. Prompts and files Codex reads are sent to OpenAI. Broad PreToolUse hooks inspect Bash, Monitor, and Workflow call text; the PermissionRequest hook is inert.
